title: Utility of CC7 Transfer in Stroke Subtypes
official: Seventh Cervical Nerve Transfer for Spastic Arm Paresis: A Prospective Analysis of Efficacy in Ischemic vs. Hemorrhagic Stroke
summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the limb functional improvement after contralateral C7 root transfer in stroke patients.

interventions.name: Contralateral C7 root transfer for the treatment of spastic hemiparesis.

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* History of ischemic or hemorrhagic stroke with resultant arm paresis that has ceased to improve within 1-5 years of rehabilitation.
* baseline Fugl-Meyer score below 33

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
